cases.notes: Point Reyes National Seashore (north Marin). Coords centered on the Palomarin trailhead (NPS Palomarin Trailhead page, 37.934/-122.7468); the falls themselves sit ~4 km NW (NPS Alamere Falls page, 37.9537/-122.7835), so a 15 km tolerance covers whichever point the model returns. parkType national = National Seashore. City intentionally omitted (Bolinas vs Point Reyes Station vs 'Point Reyes' all defensible). Source: nps.gov/pore; as of 2026-07-09. AllTrails link: a hike drafted without one, or with another trail, fails; accepted are, as AllTrails lists them, the Alamere Falls routes it lists from Palomarin, Bear Valley, Wildcat Camp, Olema Valley, and Pelican Hill by the Stewart and Glen trails, checked with the AllTrails connector on 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25.

Elkhorn Slough paddling launches from the Moss Landing North Harbor. Coords: Moss Landing / Elkhorn Slough kayak launch (paddling.com location + elkhornslough.org visit/recreation, ~36.800/-121.784). parkType omitted — the launch is a working harbor, not clearly 'in a park' (Elkhorn Slough is a state ecological reserve / National Estuarine Research Reserve; the model may reasonably omit it). As of 2026-07-09.

Mission Peak Regional Preserve, managed by EBRPD → parkType regional. Coords centered on the Stanford Avenue staging area (37°30'15.74"N 121°54'29.98"W → 37.5044/-121.9083, per AllTrails / EBRPD trailhead data); the summit sits ~3 km NE, covered by the 12 km tolerance. Source: ebparks.org/parks/mission-peak; as of 2026-07-09. costTier: free at the Stanford Ave staging area, $4 at the Ohlone College lot, so free or $ (ebparks.org/parks/mission; as of 2026-10-14). AllTrails link: a hike drafted without one, or with another trail, fails; accepted are, as AllTrails lists them, the Mission Peak routes it lists from Stanford Avenue, Ohlone College, Hidden Valley, Peak Meadow and Sunol, checked with the AllTrails connector on 2026-10-24. City: Fremont only; EBRPD places the preserve there, and Milpitas reaches it only through Ed Levin (ebparks.org/parks/mission-peak; as of 2026-10-25).

Lands End Coastal Trail, part of the Golden Gate National Recreation Area (GGNRA) → parkType national per the system prompt's explicit GGNRA=national rule. category accepts hiking OR scenic. Coords: Lands End, SF (37.786/-122.5033). Source: nps.gov GGNRA; as of 2026-07-09. costTier free: no entry or parking fee at Lands End (nps.gov/goga fees; as of 2026-10-14). AllTrails link: a hike drafted without one, or with another trail, fails; accepted are, as AllTrails lists them, Lands End Trail, its accessible stretch from Sutro Baths, Lands End Point and the Coastal Trail on to the Golden Gate Bridge, checked with the AllTrails connector on 2026-10-24.

Big Basin Redwoods STATE Park, Santa Cruz Mountains → parkType state. Region is genuinely ambiguous (Santa Cruz Mtns read as south-bay, peninsula, or central-coast depending on framing) — that ambiguity is deliberate, so all three are accepted. Coords: park HQ, 21600 Big Basin Way, Boulder Creek (37.1723/-122.2225; parks.ca.gov/bigbasin + Wikipedia infobox). 20 km tolerance because trailheads span a large park. City omitted (Boulder Creek vs 'Big Basin'). As of 2026-07-09. Owner-verified addition (2026-07-09): the park runs a post-CZU-fire day-use parking reservation system — reservations are ENCOURAGED but not required ($8 reserved incl. $2 fee, limited first-come-first-served $10; bicycle/bus arrivals exempt). Source: parks.ca.gov/post/49. Descriptions mentioning day-use/advance parking reservations are factual, not fabricated. AllTrails link: a hike drafted without one, or with another trail, fails; accepted are, as AllTrails lists them, the park’s best-known hikes from park headquarters (Berry Creek Falls in its variants, Redwood Trail, Sequoia Trail, Skyline to the Sea and Meteor, Creeping Forest, the extended loop, Big Basin to Waddell Beach, Sunset Camp and the Skyline to the Sea routes in, and the three-park loop), checked with the AllTrails connector on 2026-10-24.

Muir Woods National Monument, Marin County → parkType national, region north-bay. category accepts hiking OR scenic (old-growth redwood walk). Coords: 37.8919/-122.5708 (Wikipedia infobox; as of 2026-10-25). City omitted (Mill Valley vs 'Muir Woods'). Source: nps.gov/muwo; as of 2026-07-09. costTier: $15 entry + $10 parking reservation per car, $20 each for two → $ (gomuirwoods.com/parking; as of 2026-10-25); $$ accepted for a model that counts the car alone (nps.gov/muwo/planyourvisit/fees.htm; as of 2026-10-14).

Historic tavern at 202 Stage Rd, Pescadero → category food, restaurantFields (cuisine + priceRange must be present). No parkType (restaurant, per the system prompt's 'omit for non-park' rule). Region ambiguous: coastal San Mateo County reads as peninsula or central-coast, both accepted. Coords: 37.252/-122.3824 (Wikipedia 'Duarte's Tavern' + Yelp address). As of 2026-07-09. Owner-verified addition (2026-07-09): founded 1894 by Portuguese immigrant Frank Duarte as a saloon/barbershop; restaurant era dates to the 1930s (reopened 1935 after Prohibition; Emma Duarte began the pie-making tradition then). Famous for artichoke soup and olallieberry pie; James Beard America's Classics award 2003; run by the fourth Duarte generation. Sources: duartestavern.com history page, Wikipedia, NPR (2009). Descriptions citing the 1894 founding or the since-the-1930s restaurant era are factual, not fabricated.

Scenic coastal loop through Pebble Beach → category scenic (system prompt: 'scenic for drives/lookouts'), region central-coast. parkType omitted — privately managed by Pebble Beach Co.; model may say 'private' or omit, so it is not graded. Coords: 36.5848/-121.9651 (Wikipedia '17-Mile Drive'). 20 km tolerance (a 17-mile loop; the model may return any gate or midpoint). City accepts the towns the loop touches or has a gate in: Pebble Beach, Monterey, Pacific Grove and Carmel (Wikipedia lists a Carmel gate; added 2026-10-25). As of 2026-07-09. costTier $: $12.50 per vehicle at the gate, $ split or not (pebblebeach.com/17-mile-drive; as of 2026-10-25).

Coastal Oregon beach town (Haystack Rock). region US-OR (Oregon), by its ISO code since #274. category left generous — a beach town legitimately reads as scenic, hiking, water, or other. Coords: town center 45.8917/-123.9615 (Haystack Rock sits ~1 km SW at 45.8844/-123.9684). Source: latitude.to Cannon Beach OR + Wikipedia Haystack Rock; as of 2026-07-09.

A place outside California, which the draft must file under its own state's ISO code (#274), US-UT, not stretch a California area over it. Coords: Sunset Point, where the Navajo Loop starts (37.6229/-112.1668, NPS Bryce Canyon). parkType national; partOf the national park. AllTrails link: a hike drafted without one, or with another trail, fails; accepted are, as AllTrails lists them, Navajo Loop Trail, and Navajo Loop with Queens Garden, its usual pairing, checked with the AllTrails connector on 2026-10-24.

cases.notes: The first real share (#6): a reel listing nine Bay Area hikes, drafted as the share page seeds it (place name and city as the title; the post's link and caption as notes). Thiên Long Sơn (Dragon Mountain Park, 3215 Calaveras Rd), Vietnamese Buddhist grounds in the hills above Milpitas whose stairway (about 250 ft of steps, per Weekend Sherpa) is the hike. Its first draft came back with no AllTrails link although AllTrails lists it twice: 'Dragon Mountain Stairs' (trailhead 17 m from the drafted pin; 0.9 mi, 583 ft) and 'Dragon Mountain Trail' (2.8 mi, 1,066 ft), checked with AllTrails' own search on 2026-10-24. A prompt rule alone (search AllTrails by every name) still missed it on its first graded run; the AllTrails search (api/_allTrailsSearch.ts), which searches AllTrails itself, is what's meant to find it. Coords: the drafted pin, 37.4524/-121.8505, at the Stairs trailhead. Region: south-bay; Milpitas is in Santa Clara County (east-bay dropped 2026-10-25, when gen-mission-peak stopped accepting Milpitas). parkType not graded: private grounds, which the model may call 'private' or omit.

Pinnacles National Park → parkType national, category camping. Coords centered on Pinnacles Campground (east side, 5000 Hwy 146, Paicines: 36.4932/-121.1463, Recreation.gov #234015 / nps.gov/pinn). 20 km tolerance covers both the east (Paicines) and west (Soledad) approaches. City omitted (Paicines vs 'Pinnacles'). Region central-coast (San Benito/Monterey county). As of 2026-07-09.

input.title: Golden Gate Bridge to Sausalito bike ride

cases.notes: Classic bike ride across the Golden Gate Bridge into Sausalito → category cycling. Region ambiguous: starts in SF, ends in Marin (north-bay), so both accepted. Coords centered on the Golden Gate Bridge (37.8199/-122.4787, Wikipedia); Sausalito (37.8591/-122.4853) sits ~4.9 km N, inside the 12 km tolerance. parkType + city omitted (route spans two cities and GGNRA land). As of 2026-07-09.

expectedFailure.reason: ACTIVITY_SCHEMA forces all required fields with no refusal affordance, so the model drafts something for nonsense input rather than declining; #281 would let it decline

cases.notes: Pure-nonsense title with no real-world referent. The IDEAL behavior is to refuse (surface BAD_GATEWAY), so ifReturned=null means 'returning any object at all fails'. But the response schema marks name/category/region/lat/lng/etc. as required with no way to decline, so the model drafts a record instead of erroring, hence expectedFailure. A predicted failure scores as pass and is reported as a KNOWN FINDING; an unexpected pass (the model learned to refuse) flags that the golden set needs review. No coordinates to cite. As of 2026-07-09; on 2026-10-25 gemini-3.8-flash matched the old title's 'paddleworth' to a real church in Paddlesworth, Kent, so the title's made-up word is now one with no near match (vrennikund). #281 would add the refusal.

A place abroad, which regions name since #274: Kyoto prefecture is JP-26 (ISO 3166-2), not a California area stretched over it. Coords: the shrine's main gate, Fushimi Inari Taisha (34.9671/135.7727, Wikipedia); the trail climbs Mount Inari behind it, inside the 5 km tolerance. Category generous: the walk through the torii is a hike, a shrine visit and a sight. AllTrails link: a hike drafted without one, or with another trail, fails; accepted are, as AllTrails lists them, Fushimi Inari Walking Tour, the loop through the torii up Mount Inari, checked with the AllTrails connector on 2026-10-24.

Maximally vague prompt. Declining (BAD_GATEWAY) is acceptable; so is resolving it into a concrete activity — but if it resolves, the judge must confirm it named a REAL place whose coordinates are internally consistent (not an invented location). No fixed coordinates to cite — the judge verifies whatever the model returns. As of 2026-07-09.

Live Google-Search-grounded events for 'this weekend' near San Jose. Results are date-dependent and non-deterministic, so this is graded structurally (event count 3–14 — the prompt asks for 6–12, the bounds allow slack — ≥80% of events carry name+startDate+sourceUrl), by date-window overlap (±1 day slack), by name-dedupe, and by an LLM judge requiring ≥80% plausible events. No coordinates. As of 2026-07-09.

Live events for 'the next 7 days' near San Jose. Same structural + date-window + dedupe + judge grading as the other discover cases; results are live-web and date-dependent. No coordinates. As of 2026-07-09.

Live events for 'today' near San Jose — the tightest window, so the most likely of the three to legitimately return few results; minEvents=3 is a lenient floor. Graded structurally + date-window + dedupe + judge. No coordinates. As of 2026-07-09.

Real AllTrails page — the slug 'mission-peak-loop-from-stanford-avenue-staging-area' appears verbatim in AllTrails' own search-result listing ('11,586 Reviews'). Published stats: ~6.1 mi, ~2,145 ft gain, 4.7★. Source: AllTrails search snippet; as of 2026-07-09.

Real AllTrails page — the slug 'alamere-falls-via-coast-trail-from-palomarin-trailhead' appears verbatim in AllTrails' own search-result listing ('5,847 Reviews' as of 2026-10-25). Published stats: 13.8 mi round trip, 1,771 ft gain (2026-10-25; ~1,900 ft as of 2026-07-09), 4.8★. Bounds set generously (distance 11–16, elevation 900–2600) to absorb source variance in the reported gain; rating nullable. Source: AllTrails search snippet; as of 2026-07-09.

Syntactically valid alltrails.com URL (passes the resolver's host regex, so it DOES reach the paid call) but a fabricated, non-existent trail slug. Nothing is verifiable, so the honest outcome is all-null lookup fields, or a clean upstream BAD_GATEWAY — both accepted. No coordinates. As of 2026-07-09.

Non-AllTrails URL. The resolver's `/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?alltrails\.com\//` guard rejects it with badInput BEFORE any paid Gemini call, so this is fully deterministic — BAD_USER_INPUT is the only acceptable outcome. No coordinates. As of 2026-07-09.

input.prompt: A dog-friendly weekend on the coast: easy walks and a beach where the dog can come too.

catalog.name: Carmel Beach
catalog.shortDescription: White-sand beach below the village; dogs may run off-leash.

catalog.name: Lands End

catalog.name: Mission Peak
catalog.shortDescription: Steep, exposed climb to the summit pole and wide views.

catalog.name: Muir Woods

catalog.shortDescription: Hands-on science museum on Pier 15.

catalog.name: California Academy of Sciences
catalog.shortDescription: Aquarium, planetarium and a rainforest dome under one roof.

As of 2026-10-14.
